verdict.rationale: Together AI is an inference/training infrastructure platform (API, fine-tuning, dedicated endpoints); it provides building blocks (function calling, agentic tool loops) for others to build agents, and agent-skills/MCP tooling to make external coding agents aware of Together's docs, but it does not itself ship a built-in AI assistant inside its own product for users to delegate tasks to. This axis is a category error for an API/infra product rather than an end-user assistant product.
